svg.text: K11 The wet cell (X 1850–3600): one gantry hand cooks
Rinse cup, chute, thermo-cooker, 60 cm 4-zone hob, oven above the bench; boxes arrive on a shelf from the gallery.
5 motion actuators (X, Z, Y, roll, hatch door), 2 seals
hob 7.4 kW (2 × 3.7 kW boost) · cooker MC Smart
oven 25 L turned, hook-rod door · cell part €3.86 k

g.text: deck drains to the rinse cup

svg.text: TOP VIEW at deck level (oven, shelf and cabinet above: dotted)
X: own motor on the shared beam (omega drive), mast X 1880–3560
Z: ball screw on the hanging mast, arm z 1000–1900 — sealing band 1
Y: belt in the arm tube, wrist y 130–580 — sealing band 2
roll: canned magnet coupling on a 300 mm drop link, 10 Nm (no seal)
limits: lift ≤ 6 kg, push 300 N (y ≤ 420), 0.8 m/s
5th actuator: hatch door (NEMA 17 belt, soft edge)
box shelf z 1550: 3 stub carriers (green, green, red); lid station + magazine above
rinse cup Ø 150: spout cold / 45 / 85 °C, 4 jets 85 °C — sleeve 20 s after a raw grip
chute 120 × 200 to a 20 L bin; blade post on its rim (peeling on the spit)
thermo-cooker in a drained pocket, splash hood; two jugs alternate
tool cabinet over the hob: 3 racks, rear spring flaps to the mast lane
oven above the bench: hook rod drops the door onto the corridor
cleaning: fixed nozzle rail 85 °C + detergent; deck sloped to the rinse cup

g.text: 1/8 A box arrives: the storage gripper lowers it through the port; the lid station lifts the lid off; the box lands on a green stub carrier.
2/8 The hand lifts the carrier (its spring hooks hold the box), tips the ingredients into the pan on a rear hob zone, puts it back.
3/8 Hot sleeve rinse: four 85 °C jets wash the wrist over the rinse cup (20 s after any raw grip, else 3–10 s).
4/8 A spatula from the tool cabinet; the hand stirs the pan; the hob zone heats (one 3.7 kW boost per phase).
5/8 Thermo-cooker: the hand lifts the jug by its rear stub and pours the cooking water into the rinse cup.
6/8 Oven: the hook rod drops the door onto the corridor over the hob; a GN 1/2 tray slides in; the door is pushed shut.
7/8 Plating on the bench: two plates, the pan is poured; the hatch door slides left and the diners take the plates.
8/8 Cleaning: the fixed nozzle rail rinses liners, deck and soffits at 85 °C; the deck drains to the rinse cup.
